connector.name: Authshore
connector.registryDescription: Auth infrastructure for coding agents. User pools, secrets vault, token management. As easy as git.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.authshore.ai over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package authshore. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your AuthShore API key: 'Bearer as_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the authshore_signup tool.

env.name: AUTHSHORE_API_KEY
env.description: AuthShore API key (as_...). Get one with 'npx authshore signup <project> --email <you>' or at https://authshore.ai.
